chain.title: Dust of Old Magic
chain.desc: Explore the mod's magical structures and collect Arcane Essence from their loot. Store it for cloth and Arcane Ingots while your spell-book branch gets started.

chain.title: Your First Grimoire
chain.desc: Prepare a starter spell book, then take it to an Inscription Table with a scroll. A book is a reusable spell holder; obtaining an empty one does not mean a spell has already been inscribed.

chain.title: Where Spells Are Written
chain.desc: Use the Inscription Table to copy a scroll's spell into a compatible spell book. Check the spell level and available slots before replacing a spell you already rely on.

chain.title: A Spell on Paper
chain.desc: Search magical structures for spell scrolls. Keep a promising scroll for inscription into a book instead of consuming it for a single cast.

chain.title: Copper Binding
chain.desc: Craft a Copper Spell Book and compare its slots and bonuses with your other early books. Book types are alternatives; you do not have to replace a useful book simply because another one exists.

chain.title: Nether Leather
chain.desc: Dropped by hoglins in the nether; it backs the mid-tier spell books.

chain.title: Ink Made Permanent
chain.desc: Use the Scroll Forge with the required ink, paper and school ingredients to make a chosen spell scroll. This gives you a planned spellcrafting route alongside exploration loot.

chain.title: An Unwritten Rune
chain.desc: Collect Blank Runes from the supported loot or crafting routes. Choose a spell school before converting them, since specialised runes serve different scroll and equipment recipes.

chain.title: Silver of the Deep
chain.desc: Find Mithril Ore and collect Raw Mithril for processing. This material branch leads to equipment upgrades rather than requiring you to finish every available spell-book type.

chain.title: The Upgrade Bench
chain.desc: Place the Arcane Anvil and inspect its available equipment upgrades. Keep the base equipment, Upgrade Orbs and any additional ingredients ready before committing to a change.

chain.title: Charred Pages
chain.desc: Recovered from ancient city chests and the Citadel's bookshelves.

chain.title: Ash of the Fire Boss
chain.desc: Recover Cinder Essence from the encounters or treasure listed by the installed mod. It connects the combat branch to the cauldron and equipment-upgrade workshop.

chain.title: Vault Metal
chain.desc: Explore the Citadel and recover its Pyrium treasure. Treat the area as an expedition: bring combat equipment, healing and enough inventory space to return with the prize.

chain.title: Whispers From the Deep Dark
chain.desc: Gather the Ancient Knowledge Fragments needed for an Eldritch Manuscript. Follow the guide's eldritch research path; the manuscript is a learning item, not a scroll containing every eldritch spell.

chain.title: Woven With Essence
chain.desc: Eight arcane essence pressed around a block of wool.

chain.title: Gilded Tome
chain.desc: Use Hogskin and Arcane Essence to prepare the Gold Spell Book. Move a tested spell set into it at the Inscription Table and check how its bonuses affect your casting.

chain.title: The Brewing Vat
chain.desc: Set up the Alchemist Cauldron for the ink and potion recipes shown in the guide. Prepare ingredients for the specific ink tier you need before trying to supply the Scroll Forge.

chain.title: Essence Made Solid
chain.desc: Eight arcane essence compressed around a base ingot.

chain.title: Mithril Drawn Out
chain.desc: Four mithril scrap, blasted from raw mithril, folded together in a two-by-two.

chain.title: Skin of the Ender Dragon
chain.desc: Use Dragonskin and a Ruined Book to make the Dragonskin Spell Book. Compare its strengths with your other late books and build a spell loadout suited to the encounters ahead.

chain.title: A Spell You Can Keep
chain.desc: Inscribe a scroll into your spell book at the Inscription Table and successfully cast it. Confirm this checkpoint after the spell works; an empty book alone does not complete the exercise.

chain.title: Choose Your Own Spell
chain.desc: Use the Scroll Forge to create a spell scroll from its required ingredients. Confirm after the craft succeeds, then decide whether to inscribe it or save it for another book.

chain.title: Robes of the Apprentice
chain.desc: Turn Magic Cloth into a first wizard robe. Compare the mana and spell bonuses with your current armour so the new equipment supports the spells you actually use.

chain.title: Crystal Bound
chain.desc: Prepare the Diamond Spell Book when its materials are available. Compare it with the specialised books you have found and keep the option that fits your spells.

chain.title: A Blank Enhancement
chain.desc: Prepare an Upgrade Orb from Mithril, Arcane Ingots and the listed ingredients. Apply a suitable orb at the Arcane Anvil to improve equipment you already use.

chain.title: Bound in Netherite
chain.desc: Combine the Ruined Book with the rare ingredients shown in the Netherite Spell Book recipe. Inscribe a deliberate spell set rather than filling the stronger book with spells you never cast.

chain.title: Equip the Build You Play
chain.desc: Apply a suitable Upgrade Orb to supported equipment at the Arcane Anvil. Confirm after checking the upgraded item's tooltip.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Exploration loot, reusable spells, scroll crafting, alternative book families and equipment upgrades.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
